former_id.description: Optional; unset in 1.0.0 (no earlier history). Reserved for an ID this rule had in an earlier released edition.

related.description: Relations to other rules: keys in `meta.relation_types` order, IDs in U, R, C numeric order. Both directions are recorded: every `strengthens`/`checks` has its inverse `strengthened_by`/`checked_by` on the target rule and vice versa, and `conflicts_with` is stated on both rules. `depends_on` and `scaled_by` have no inverse type and stay one-way.

related_text.description: Optional. Verbatim RELATED cell when it cannot be regenerated from `related` (non-rule targets, `(see Kn)` pointers, qualifiers).

evidence.description: Evidence level (the leading word of the Evidence cell).

evidence_note.description: Text inside the parentheses when the Evidence cell is exactly `<level> (<note>)`; otherwise null.

evidence_text.description: Optional. The verbatim Evidence cell when it is not `<level>` or `<level> (<note>)`; renderers print it instead of evidence/evidence_note.

source_domain.description: Markdown; sources are cited only as Pandoc citations `[@slug]`.

counterexample.description: C-rules only: the counterexample system (class_note after `counterexample: `).

sources.description: Section 9 sources: every primary source first, then the secondary ones, each kind in its edition-9 cell order.

source_titles.description: Per-use link-title overrides: slug -> the title this cell uses when it differs from sources.yaml `title`. Renderers use it instead of the canonical title for this use only.

name.description: The "Rule name" column of section 10, verbatim (equals the rule's name in edition 9).

form_name.description: The "Management name" column: the name of the rule's management form.

form.description: "THEN (management form)": the rule's action stated for an organization.

sources.description: Management sources cited in the cell, in cell order (may be empty: "cross-reference only").

sources_text.description: Optional. The Sources cell with links as `[@slug]` when it is not just the `; `-joined citations (extra words such as "(supports)", "cross-reference only", "section 9 (...)").
